dimensions.assessment: Applies to companies or individuals under investigation for export control violations by the Department of Commerce.

dimensions.assessment: Doubles the timeframe during which individuals and companies can be prosecuted or penalized for violations.
dimensions.evidence: extends from 5 to 10 years the statute of limitations for civil and criminal violations of U.S. export control laws

dimensions.evidence: To amend the Export Control Reform Act of 2018 to provide for a ten-year statute of limitations for export control violations

importance_detail.rationale: This bill extends the statute of limitations for civil and criminal export control violations from 5 to 10 years, increasing legal exposure for individuals and companies under investigation.
